cases.question: How many PTO days do new employees get, and can unused days roll over?

gold_chunk: carry over up to 5 unused PTO days

answer.content:
New full-time employees receive **18 days of PTO per calendar year**, accruing at **1.5 days per month** starting on the first day of employment; part-time employees accrue PTO in proportion to their scheduled hours. [S1]

Employees may carry over **up to 5 unused PTO days** into the next calendar year, but must use them by **March 31**. Other unused days are forfeited on **December 31** and are not paid out, except where local law requires a payout. [S1]

LRK-4471 was the August platform outage: on August 12, 2026, a failed database migration caused a 9-hour outage of Larkspur’s forecasting platform, affecting 41 customers. [S1]

- **Root cause:** A schema change was applied without a tested rollback plan. [S1]

cases.question: What is the remote work stipend? Has it changed?

gold_chunk: remote work stipend of $500 per year

answer.content:
The remote work stipend is **$750 per year**, effective October 1, 2026; it increased from **$500 per year** following board approval after the spring employee survey. [S2]

- The handbook effective January 15, 2026 still lists $500 per year, but the more recent board update, prepared October 2, 2026, gives the updated amount and says People Operations will revise the handbook in its next edition. [S1][S4][S2][S6]
- The handbook says the stipend covers internet, furniture and other home-office costs, is paid in the January payroll, and is prorated for employees who join during the year. [S1]

cases.question: Which vendor is cheaper over three years, and which has the stronger SLA?

answer.content:
**BrightPath is cheaper over three years on the stated subscription rates; CoreLink has the stronger SLA**, with higher uptime and larger service-credit percentages per shortfall increment. [S1][S2]

- **BrightPath:** $420,000 + 3 × $60,000 = **$600,000**, excluding applicable taxes. [S1]
- **CoreLink:** $380,000 + 3 × $95,000 = **$665,000**, assuming its stated annual subscription remains unchanged in year 3; pricing is locked only for the first 24 months. [S2]
- **Difference:** $665,000 − $600,000 = **$65,000** in BrightPath’s favor under that assumption; CoreLink’s year 3 subscription price is not guaranteed in the supplied terms. [S1][S2]

**SLA comparison:**
- **CoreLink:** 99.9% monthly uptime; credits of 10% of the monthly subscription fee for each 0.1% below target, capped at 50% of the monthly fee; 24/7 support. [S2]
- **BrightPath:** 99.5% monthly uptime; credits of 5% of that month’s subscription fee for each 0.5% below target; business-hours support (8:00 to 18:00 Mountain Time), with a 4-hour response target for priority 1 issues. [S1][S3]

cases.question: And after three years?
turns: How many PTO days do new employees get, and can unused days roll over?

answer.content:
After three years of continuous service, full-time employees receive **20 PTO days per year**: 18 base days + 2 additional days = 20 days; the increase applies from the first full month after the employee’s third work anniversary. [S1]

Unused PTO can roll over, subject to these limits: [S1]
- Up to **5 unused PTO days** may carry into the next calendar year and must be used by **March 31**. [S1]
- Any other unused days are forfeited on **December 31** and are not paid out, except where local law requires a payout. [S1]
